research_question: What preserves independent other agents when their instrumental utility vanishes, external accountability is absent, and exploitative material payoff is favorable? How distinguish intrinsic costly concern from image, norm, avoidance, choice-set and experimenter effects?
scope: 22 original empirical/formal papers with 21 DOI + 1 stable journal/index record, not full systematic recall. C01 exact keys crosscheck: no identical DOI; this does not prove no older mentions in repository.
screening_method: purposive multi-source backwards/forwards conceptual tracing; primary publisher/original author sources prioritized, independent index cross-check where accessible
key_threads: anonymous fairness and internal subjective value
social norms, image, self-respect and reward crowd-out
2025-2026 newer primary studies and conceptual replication
